text: Coffee with Claire. She's got a second interview at the council on Friday at 3pm and is properly nervous about the presentation bit. Her sister Hana gets married in the spring, venue still not booked. Text Claire good luck Friday morning.
Femi and Bethany celebrate ten years next Saturday. They're doing a quiet dinner, no fuss. Bethany hinted that a nice bottle of red would go down well.

Long catch up with Julien after squash. He applied for the senior designer role at Fischer & co and hears back sometime next week. His girlfriend Saskia started pottery classes and is obsessed. Ask him on Monday if he heard anything.
Rohan rang. Engagement party is off, they've decided to wait till after Christmas. He sounded fine about it honestly. His mum is still planning a family lunch this weekend though.
Dentist tomorrow at 8.40, then pick up dry cleaning.
Aditi passed her probation!! Started at the hospital pharmacy in the summer. Her husband Darius is taking her away for a long weekend in a fortnight to celebrate. Send congrats.
Bumped into Magda at the station. Her daughter got an interview for medicine at Leeds, the 12th at half 9. Magda is more stressed than the daughter is.
Olga and Thomas got engaged on holiday in Lisbon! Wedding probably next summer, maybe sooner. She showed me the ring, vintage, his gran's. Need to get them a card this week.
Kiri's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday and is on the sofa in a cone. Kiri works from home now so she can keep an eye on him. Check how he's doing Thursday.
Noah's leaving do is Friday from 6, the Crown. I'm going straight from work.
Dawit had his interview with the bank this morning, said it went ok but one panel member was really cold. Hears back end of the month. Remind me to ask him next Tuesday.

Chat with Irina over lunch. She and her partner Abdi are thinking about eloping rather than a big wedding, sometime in the spring. Her parents would be gutted though. Abdi's brother Akira is getting married in June so they don't want to clash. She's also applying for a part-time MA, deadline soon. Irina is vegan now, remember for the dinner.
Ebony's anniversary with Rohan was yesterday, she said he forgot until lunchtime lol.
Lola's been out of work since August and is getting a bit low about it. Three applications in, one phone screen next Wednesday afternoon. I should send her that recruiter's details tonight.
Saskia's mum turns 70 on Sunday. Big lunch at theirs, I'm bringing dessert.

Called Matilda. Her nan passed away last week, funeral is Thursday at 11. She's holding up but tired. Her boyfriend Noah is driving her up to Durham Wednesday evening. Must send flowers to the house before then.
Deepa Usman, Dee to everyone, got the head of maths job! Starts after Easter. She was so nervous going in. Take her for a drink this weekend.
Salma and Femi are moving in together sometime next month. Flat in Peckham, two bed, has a garden for her cat Pepper. Femi's still waiting on his new contract at the agency.
Note: Blessing collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul. Good for Christmas.

Emily's wedding dress fitting is Saturday morning, then the hen do is in three weeks. Her maid of honour Yara dropped out, long story, so Emily asked her cousin instead. Don't forget to pay my share of the hen house by Friday.
Laura texted. Interview at the museum moved from Monday to Tuesday at 2. She's prepping all weekend.
Akira had a rough week, his dad is in hospital with pneumonia. He's flying to Osaka tomorrow night. Should message him once he lands.
Thomas and Olga's engagement drinks, Saturday 7pm, upstairs at the Fox. Thomas asked if I'd say a few words. Need to write something by Thursday.
Rebecca Garcia from the old office is applying for jobs again. She hates the commute. Wants something remote, maybe after Christmas.

Quick catch up with Dong at the school gate. His wife Lin is expecting in March, second one. Their eldest starts reception in September. He's applied for a promotion at work too, interviews in the new year. A lot going on for them. Ask about the interview in January.

Agnieszka is struggling with the job hunt, eight rejections now. She has an assessment centre next Thursday morning and is dreading the group exercise. Her husband keeps telling her she'll be fine. Call her Wednesday night to wish her luck.
Hana's wedding is in April, the 18th I think. Saskia is bridesmaid. Hana asked if I can do the readings.
Darius and Aditi's 5th anniversary is next week. Darius wants ideas, she's into houseplants and old maps.

Sat with Bethany at the kids' football. Her son Max got into the county squad! Training every Tuesday evening from now on. Bethany's back at work in January after maternity leave and is nervous about it. Her partner Femi has a job interview in Manchester tomorrow morning, might mean a move. They haven't decided anything yet.
Gym, then food shop, then call the landlord about the boiler. Saturday sorted.
Femi's interview in Manchester went well apparently, second round in a fortnight. Ask him what the salary is like.
Julien heard back, didn't get the Fischer job. He's gutted. Check in with him tomorrow evening.
Yara's brother Abdi Ibrahim is getting engaged at the weekend, she's sworn to secrecy, proposal on Sunday at sunset. Yara is helping with the photos.
Irina said the MA application went in. She finds out sometime in February.
Claire got the council job!! Starts 4th November. Her mum cried apparently. Celebratory drinks next Friday at 8.

Matilda's been offered a place on the nursing course starting in January. Her boyfriend Noah is thrilled. She's worried about money though, might keep the café shifts. Send her the bursary link I found.
Kiri mentioned she's allergic to nuts, seriously. Keep in mind for the anniversary dinner on the 30th.
Rohan's parents' 40th wedding anniversary is next month, sometime around the 20th. He and his sister are organising a surprise party. I'm in charge of the playlist.
Lola had the phone screen this afternoon, she got through to the next stage! Interview in person Monday at 10. Text her good luck Sunday night.
Ran into Dr Wang at the pharmacy, she's retiring after Christmas. 30 years at the practice.
Dawit got the bank job. Starts on the 2nd. His wife Selam is pregnant too, due in the spring. Massive month for them. Must get a card for both.
Ebony asked if I'd be a reference for her application at the charity. She needs it by Wednesday. Write it tomorrow.
Emily and Thomas Bianchi are celebrating their first anniversary in Rome next week. She's been learning Italian on Duolingo for it.
Haven't heard from Deepa since she started the new job. Message her this week.

Phone call with Aditi this evening. Her brother Rohan's engagement is back on, they've set a date for the spring. Their mum is already planning a huge do. Aditi's mostly worried about the cost because she's offered to help, and she's also mid way through a job application at the trust, interview pencilled in for the 14th at 3. She doesn't want to say anything to Rohan yet. Ask her how the interview went on the 15th.
Salma's grandma is 95 tomorrow. Salma is going to Bradford for the day.
Magda's daughter got the Leeds offer for medicine! Magda sent about twenty emojis. Congratulate them both.
Olga's looking at venues this weekend, Saturday morning at a barn near Hitchin, Sunday a hotel in town. She hates fuss. Thomas wants big.
Blessing's cat Juno went missing Thursday night. She's put posters up. Ask her tomorrow if Juno turned up.
Lunch with Noah and Julien. Noah's starting a new job at the BBC in a fortnight, contract role. Julien is applying to the same team. Both into climbing now, they go Wednesdays.
Car MOT Friday at 9. Book the train for next weekend.
Saskia and her husband Akira had their wedding blessing in Kyoto last month. Photos are amazing. She wants to show me properly next time.
Salma said Femi got the agency contract, finally. They pick up the keys to the Peckham flat on the 1st. I'm helping them move that Saturday.
Darius was a bit flat today. His review at work is Thursday at 4 and he thinks they're cutting the team. He's been there six years. Should ring him Thursday evening.
Rebecca's in Spain till Sunday, back at work Monday.

Laura's museum interview went really well, she thinks. Hears back by Friday. Her girlfriend Kiri is cooking her a celebratory dinner either way. Laura loves those Portuguese custard tarts, could bring some round.

Catch up with Hana and her fiancé Dawit Osei. Wedding moved to May because the venue double booked April. They're both stressed about it. Dawit is also job hunting, has an interview with a law firm next Thursday at 11. Hana's dad is paying for the flowers. Text Dawit good luck Wednesday night.
Agnieszka's assessment centre is done, she won't know for a fortnight. Proud of her for going.

Big week coming. Monday dinner at Claire's, Wednesday morning Lola's interview, Friday at 3pm Aditi's anniversary lunch, then Saturday Thomas and Olga's engagement drinks. Must pick up the present for Olga by Thursday.

Proper catch up with Yara and Abdi tonight. The engagement went perfectly, Sunday at sunset like planned, and her mum has already started talking about a wedding in the autumn. Abdi just finished his trial shifts at the new restaurant and they've offered him sous chef from next month. Yara on the other hand is stuck at her job and wants out, she's looking at teacher training for next September. She also mentioned she's coeliac, didn't know that. Need to book somewhere gluten free for their engagement dinner on the 9th.
